entries.text: Hi, it's Mia from Replogle Globes. Thanks for talking with me: the reward is $35 off. To unlock your code, you need to say at least 1,200 words on this call: the "Your words" bar at the bottom of your screen counts them. You can stop whenever you like, but it only unlocks once you reach that. I see you were looking at the Large Laminated World Wall Map. It's sold out right now. What were you hoping it would do for you?
